source: founder chat: device '117 Hz auf 0.5 Hz auf zwei Ausgänge, Resonanz über Rosenquarz' (Krohne-context, unidentified)
idea: a tone device: 117 Hz carrier with a 0.5 Hz beat or pulse on two outputs, plus a rose-quartz 'resonator'
rationale: Technically most likely a binaural beat (117 Hz one ear, 117.5 Hz other → 0.5 Hz difference) or a 117 Hz tone pulsed at 0.5 Hz; which one needs the device's name/photo/manual. Rose quartz cannot set or shape a 117 Hz resonance (a quartz resonator needs a precisely cut, electroded crystal and rings in kHz–MHz); as a lump it is decoration. No evidence for 117 Hz or a 0.5 Hz beat healing anything; binaural-beat meta-analyses show at most small mood/attention effects. Echoel already holds the honest form: EntrainmentEngine paces an isochronic pulse from the MEASURED breath (resonance ~0.1 Hz), not a fixed 0.5 Hz. Allowed as a sound-design preset (a 117 Hz drone with a slow pulse) with zero claims.
